title: Delete guard: rm -rf in the main checkout is refused

message.text: Plan: the hook that already stops git stash/reset/checkout/clean in the main checkout (git-guard.mjs) learns two more refusals — a recursive delete whose target is inside main, and any delete fed by git's own file listing. Worktrees, the scratchpad and the temp dirs stay open; deleting one file by its exact path stays open everywhere. Tests include the incident's own command shape. One Sonnet minion, ahead of the card-pipeline work. Brief: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/delete-guard/requirements.md ($8).

Done, by me: the spawn queue dropped the minion twice in five minutes (five long turns hold every slot), and a safety gap should not wait on that. git-guard.mjs now refuses a recursive delete whose target is inside the main checkout — from any cwd — and any delete fed by git's own file listing when run in main. Worktrees, the scratchpad, %TEMP% and /tmp stay open, and deleting one file by its exact path stays open everywhere. 50 test checks pass, including the incident's own command shape (git status | xargs rm -rf) and the PowerShell version. Live for every session's next command once committed; no restart.
